payload.title: A site defines its own Story procedure
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-a29894.

`newsroom_process.STEPS` is one global list that gates publishing. Per-site procedure profiles are planned in PPY-7a61ca; Humorus needs them before its first automated piece.
